description: This file defines a report for campaign efficiency analysis in ERPNext, including functions to generate report columns, gather lead data, and compute various counts and metrics related to leads, quotations, opportunities, and sales orders.

methods.name: get_columns
methods.description: Returns the column definitions for the report based on a given field name.

methods.name: get_lead_data
methods.description: Fetches lead data grouped by a specified field, calculating counts and percentages for quotations, opportunities, and orders.

methods.name: get_filter_conditions
methods.description: Builds SQL conditions based on provided date filters.

methods.name: get_lead_quotation_count
methods.description: Counts quotations associated with a list of leads.

methods.name: get_lead_opp_count
methods.description: Counts opportunities associated with a list of leads.

methods.name: get_quotation_ordered_count
methods.description: Counts quotations with 'Ordered' status associated with a list of leads.

methods.name: get_order_amount
methods.description: Calculates total order amount for a list of leads.
